title: Start from a template
subtitle: Ready-made flows: pick one, fill in your files and chats, and publish.

quote-of-the-week.title: Quote of the week
quote-of-the-week.description: Every Monday, draws the next quote from your spreadsheet in Pincel, sends you a preview on Telegram to approve, then posts it (to your chat, or a channel you choose).

folder-to-email.title: Email new files from a folder
folder-to-email.description: When a PDF is saved in a folder (scans, invoices, exports), emails it to you as an attachment.

weekly-sheet-summary.title: Weekly spreadsheet summary
weekly-sheet-summary.description: Every Friday afternoon, AI reads a spreadsheet (sales, expenses, tasks) and emails you a short summary.
